prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Mathematics and Physics

learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and describe static mechanical systems.
Calculate forces and moments under static conditions.
Transform mechanical components and systems into static models.
Formulate and solve mathematical equations for static models.
Address mechanical problems using engineering science tools and methods.
Understand the basic concepts of statics and Newton's third law of motion.
Describe forces, groups of forces, and distributed loads using vector calculus.
Determine bearing reactions and internal forces in trusses and frames.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of statics in technical mechanics
Central force systems and general force systems
Internal forces in single-part and multi-part support systems
Loading by individual and distributed loads, calculation of centroids
Coulomb's law of friction, belt adhesion and belt friction
assessment_rules: The module grade for MECB120 corresponds to the grade for MECB121. The examination is a 120-minute written exam.
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Mechatronik (B.Eng.)
